text.content:
The bar owner whose death made the Mox.

Role: Bar owner (dead)
Where to find them: Her portrait hangs over the bar at Lizzie's, Kabuki
Status: Killed by Tyger Claws in 2067

Elizabeth "Lizzie" Borden owned a club in Kabuki and stood up for the people who worked there. Her feud with the Tyger Claws ended in 2067 when Claws killed her; Minako Arasaka of Danger Gal proved it. Three nights of riots followed across the city, and out of them came the Mox, still headquartered in her club, renamed Lizzie's Bar. Kabuki remembers her every year on Lizzie's Night, when every Tyger Claw stays home.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.26; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 05
